services.name: Menu_PlaySelectionChangeCue
services.behavior: Sends audio command 0x06 through Audio_SendCommand; the two callers are menu selection-change branches.

services.name: Input_TestControllerReleased
services.behavior: Performs two controller-port phases with Z80 bus acquisition, samples IO_PORT1_DATA, tests the relevant button bits, and leaves a release predicate in the condition codes for its callers.

services.name: Menu_RenderControlBindings
services.behavior: Invokes the scene command-stream renderer three times at consecutive row positions using the selected control-layout record.

evidence.control_layout_pointer: MENU_CONTROL_LAYOUT_PTR is initialized to ROM 0x00004036 by the startup path. The menu adds 0x12 to the selected record to install three callback pointers, then Menu_RenderControlBindings consumes the following trigger-label data.
evidence.selection_audio: The menu's primary and secondary selection-change branches call 0x001B329E, which sends command 0x06 without reading a new command ID.

conclusion: The menu input/presentation path now distinguishes controller release testing, trigger-binding rendering, and the fixed selection-change audio command. The broader meaning of the control-layout callback entries remains shared with the existing terrain callback model.
